cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: After Frodo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust The One Ring and spend 1 [fellowship] resource to target the attacking enemy. Then, this attack deals no damage and each player raises his threat by 2.
cards.flavor: "But there is more about you now than appears on the surface." <cite>Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Chamber of Mazarbul
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
The players cannot advance to the next stage.  Travel: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a different enemy and adds it to the staging area to travel here. One of those enemies must be Orc-chieftan, if able.

cards.name: Moria Orc
cards.text: When Revealed: Either remove 1 damage from Doom, Doom, Doom, or reveal an additional encounter card.
cards.shadow: Shadow: The defending player raises his threat by 1 for each enemy engaged with him.

cards.name: Mines of Moria
cards.text: While Mines of Moria is in the staging area, progress must be placed on Mines of Moria before it can be placed on the current quest.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards a non-objective attachment he controls (2 non-objective attachments instead if his threat is 35 or higher).

cards.name: Ancient Guardroom
cards.text: While Ancient Guardroom is the active location, each enemy in play gets -1 [attack].  Travel: Discard the top card of the encounter deck to travel here. Each player raises his threat by X, where X is the discarded card's [threat].

cards.name: Fool of a Took!
cards.text:
Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Remove 1 damage token from Doom, Doom, Doom, or The Balrog makes an attack, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, reveal 1 card from the encounter deck.

cards.name: The Bridge of Kazad-dûm
cards.text: When Revealed: Add The Great Bridge to the staging area. Each player reveals 1 encounter card and removes 1 damage token from Doom, Doom, Doom.
cards.back_text: No more than 5 progress can be placed on this stage each round.  The players cannot defeat this stage while The Great Bridge is in play. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

cards.name: Deep Fissure
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Remove a character you control from the quest and discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that character's printed [willpower] is less than the discarded card's [threat], discard that character.

cards.name: The Long Dark of Moria
cards.text: Setup: Set The Balrog, The Great Bridge, and Chamber of Mazarbul aside out of play. Add Doom, Doom, Doom to the staging area and place 10 damage tokens on it. Each player adds 1 different location to the staging area.
cards.back_text: Forced: After a player optionally engages an enemy, remove 1 damage token from Doom, Doom, Doom.

cards.name: The Great Bridge
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
Response: When The Great Bridge is explored, discard a hero from play to deal X damage to The Balrog. X is that hero's threat cost. Then, The Balrog loses all keywords for the remainder of the game. Any player may trigger this response.

cards.name: The Balrog
cards.text:
Indestructible. Cannot be optionally engaged. The Balrog and shadow cards dealt to The Balrog are immune to player card effects.
While in the staging area, The Balrog is considered to be engaged with the first player and only the first player can declare attackers against The Balrog.

cards.name: They Are Coming!
cards.text:
Doomed 2.
When Revealed: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until X enemies are discarded. X is the number of players in the game. Add each enemy discarded this way to the staging area.

cards.name: Moria Archer
cards.text:
Peril. Archery 2.
X is the number of players in the game.  When Revealed: Assign X damage among characters you control.

cards.name: We Cannot Get Out
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the number of exhausted characters he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Assign X damage among characters you control. X is the number of enemies engaged with you.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer.  Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of attached hero.   If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Darkened Stairway
cards.text: Forced: After Darkened Stairway is explored, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card is a location, add it to the staging area.

cards.name: Uruk from Mordor
cards.text: When Revealed: Uruk from Mordor makes an attack against the first player.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, attacking enemy makes an additional attack.

cards.name: Drums in the Deep
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Chamber of Mazarbul to the staging area.
cards.back_text: If there are no enemies in the staging area at the beginning of the quest phase, the first player reveals an additional encounter card during the staging step.  The players cannot advance unless there are X resource tokens on this stage. X is the number of players times 3.  Forced: After an enemy is defeated, place 1 resource token on this stage.

cards.name: Orc-chieftan
cards.text:
Cannot have attachments. Allies cannot defend against Orc-chieftan.
Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, Orc-chieftan engages the first player.

cards.name: Doom, Doom, Doom
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the quest phase, remove 1 damage token from Doom, Doom, Doom. Then, if there are no damage tokens here, add The Balrog to the staging area.  Forced: At the end of the quest phase, The Balrog makes an attack if it is in play.

cards.name: Many-pillard Hall
cards.text: Many-pillard Hall gets +1 [threat] for each Many-pillared Hall in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if the defending player's threat is 35 or higher).

cards.name: Great Cave-troll
cards.text:
Cannot have attachments.
For each point of excess combat damage dealt by Great Cave-troll (damage that is dealt beyond the remaining hit points of the character damaged by its attack) remove 1 progress from the current quest.
